$comment: Hand-written expected values for fixtures/specs/qa/hostile-content.yaml (criterion 19). 'markdown' entries are Markdown fields: 'safeForm' is sanitizeMarkdown(authored).text by the rewrite table of ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown' (null where the table leaves white space undetermined; then 'visibleIncludes'/'visibleExcludes' apply), and 'visible' is the text a reader sees. 'text' entries are tenant strings that are not Markdown: 'escaped' is escapeMarkdownText(authored) by ADR 0003 'escapeMarkdownText'. 'slug' is by ADR 0002 'Identifiers', Slug. 'url' entries are not Markdown and must never become a live link. Every entry also falls under 'pageAssertions'.

strings.rule: ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': raw inline HTML, each '<' written '<'
Standing constraint: tenant content is never executed. ADR 0003 'linkDestinationAllowed' refuses it; no page or twin may hold it as an href
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': a refused link is its link text alone; the destination is dropped
ADR 0003 'escapeMarkdownText'; ADR 0002 Slug
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': an HTML block, each '<' written '<'; shown as the text that was typed, no image, no request to tracker.example
ADR 0002: a declared operationId is used verbatim; its slug keeps ASCII a-z0-9 runs joined by '-'
ADR 0003 'escapeMarkdownText'
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': refused link
ADR 0003 'escapeMarkdownText'; ADR 0005 'Text outside ASCII' rule 1 for the name in the URL
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': an image is escapeMarkdownText of its alt text; never an image, no remote host contacted
Criterion 19: an example is shown as inert text; ADR 0005 rule 1 in the URL
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': a data: destination is refused
Criterion 19: enum values inert. The first enum value is the sample value (ADR 0005 'Rules', fill order)
Criterion 19
Criterion 19: an attribute break-out attempt
Criterion 19

ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': a reference link whose destination is refused is its link text alone, and the definition is removed. White space left after removing the definition is not specified (question QA-5)
Control. ADR 0003: an inline link whose destination is allowed is unchanged
Criterion 19; ADR 0005 'Variables are structure, never marker text': '{{api_key}}' is literal text in every sample, never a variable
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': an HTML block (comment and style), each '<' written '<'
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': inline HTML in a paragraph (not a type 7 block: text follows the tag on its line)
A property name; escapeMarkdownText leaves it unchanged (no character it escapes). On a page it must be text, never an attribute
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown': an autolink is text, its '<' written '<'
Criterion 19
A schema name: escapeMarkdownText; ADR 0002 Slug
ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown'

pageAssertions.rule: Criterion 19, checked in the built pages and in the twins: tenant content executes nothing, and no remote host is contacted.
html: no <script> element other than the app's own
no attribute whose name begins with 'on' that came from tenant text
no href, src, action, formaction or srcset whose value begins with 'javascript:' or 'data:', in any letter case
no , from tenant text, and no request to tracker.example or attacker.example while the page loads
twins: parsed by parseMarkdown: no html, image, imageReference or definition node (ADR 0003 'Tenant Markdown', Tests)
every link is one the engine wrote to another twin or passes linkDestinationAllowed

findings.exactCodesRule: No description here needs the fallback (each is short, shallow and settles in one pass), so markdown-not-rendered is not expected (ADR 0003 'Fallback').
